correctness.rationale: Verified normalized weighted-ball monomial norms and independent beta-binomial representation. The commutator sends each normalized basis vector to a distinct normalized basis vector with the positive stated binomial mass times the exact multiplication ratio; hence singular values are exactly the weights. Uniform Stirling local CLT and strong binomial log-concavity give both the Gaussian local profile and a global Gaussian majorant. Dominated sums show the p=3 threshold. A rigorously truncated degree/window Riemann sum gives epsilon^3 N(epsilon) -> sqrt(t)(1-t)^2/(3 pi sqrt(3)), with low-degree contribution O(sqrt(delta)) and no high-degree contributions after a sufficiently large cutoff. The derivative gives the unique t=1/5 maximum. A standalone script passed 1640 supplementary finite checks. Risk: numerical checks do not replace uniform bounds; those bounds are separately justified in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: A natural discontinuous geometric Toeplitz symbol on the weighted complex ball produces a compact commutator with an explicitly determined critical Schatten exponent p=3 and a sharp boundary-density coefficient. The independence from the radial weight and unique optimal angular interface at t=1/5 are intrinsic structural answers, not arbitrary truncated constants. They distinguish a discontinuous jump from known smooth-symbol weak-ideal results and quantify the full tail of a natural operator family.
